defs.def: in the place of sb/sth 代替；顶替；反而；却

ex.s: Instead, encourage them to do differently next time.
ex.t: 相反，鼓励他们下次换一种不同的做法。

ex.s: My roommates would tell me to go to bed and get up early the following morning to do it instead.
ex.t: 室友们会劝我去睡觉，第二天早上早点起来再做。

ex.s: Instead, people with stronger moral character tend to experience greater meaning in life and happiness.
ex.t: 做到清晰简洁——同时保持趣味性并包含听众需要知道的所有信息——这是一种高水平的沟通技巧。

ex.s: Many parents say there’s too much traffic on the roads for their children to walk safely to school, so they pack them into the car instead.
ex.t: 这是我从未体验过的一种快感。

ex.s: Some teachers don’t give the kids any assignments; they express sympathy instead.
ex.t: 本期不会告诉你你的结局应该是什么——这取决于你和你要讲的故事——但它可能会提供你达成目标所需要的帮助。

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.
ex.t: 那次事件后，我不再担任“汉语老师”。“当别人挣扎着说出我的名字时，我没有纠正别人，我只是微笑着点头表示赞许。

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 相反，她建议采用营养专家中一个知名的理念，叫做“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供各种大多健康的食物，而孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着偶尔吃更多饼干而非胡萝卜。

ex.s: Instead of simply complaining, he decided to do something about it.
ex.t: 他决定不再只是抱怨，而是为此做点什么。

ex.s: Instead, surround yourself with healthy choices.
ex.t: 相反，让自己周围都是健康的选择。

ex.s: She stopped thinking about the word “mile.” Instead, she focused on reaching the shadow cast on the track by an oak tree up ahead.
ex.t: 她不再去想"英里"这个词。相反，她专注于跑到前方一棵橡树投在跑道上的影子处。

ex.s: We can, instead, use this idea to advance scientific knowledge.
ex.t: 相反，我们可以利用这个想法来推进科学知识。

ex.s: Instead, they are rooted in the similarity of basic human needs and our shared mechanisms for learning and problem solving.
ex.t: 相反，它们根植于基本人类需求的相似性以及我们共同的学习和解决问题的机制。

ex.s: Instead, they grow better inside, where it is warmer
ex.t: 相反，它们在更温暖的室内长得更好

ex.s: However, instead of the brownish red hair she had hoped for, she final got purple hair.
ex.t: 然而，她最终得到的不是她希望的红棕色头发，而是紫色的头发。

ex.s: This year, instead of cooking at home for her husband and friends, she celebrated the Chinese New Year with various dishes from local restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 今年，她没有在家为丈夫和朋友做饭，而是用唐人街当地餐馆的各种菜肴来庆祝中国新年。

ex.s: But instead of passing it through the hole to the dog, they would then pull it out of its reach.
ex.t: 但他们没有把它穿过洞递给狗，而是把它拉到狗够不着的地方。

ex.s: That project, which I could complete from my sofa instead of in the burning heat of the desert, not only survived the lockdown but worked where traditional methods didn’t.
ex.t: 那个项目我可以坐在沙发上完成，而不必在沙漠的酷热中进行，它不仅在封锁期间存活了下来，而且在传统方法不起作用的地方发挥了作用。

ex.s: Instead, all that matters is next quarter’s profit, or satisfying some other near-term desires.
ex.t: 相反，重要的只是下个季度的利润，或满足某些其他近期欲望。

ex.s: Instead, enjoy its diversity.
ex.t: 相反，我享受它的多样性。

ex.s: Instead, they explode in your mouth like little flavor bombs.
ex.t: 相反，它们在你嘴里像小炸弹一样爆开，充满风味。

ex.s: "Instead, our results suggest that the successful dogs realized that a smiling mouth means the same thing as smiling eyes, and the same rule applies to an angry mouth having the same meaning as angry eyes.”
ex.t: “相反，我们的结果表明，成功的狗意识到微笑的嘴和微笑的眼睛表达的是同一意思，同样的规则也适用于生气的嘴和生气的眼睛含义相同。”

ex.s: Then someone said, "Now you can use your Grandma's Box." From then on instead of coming to ask their possessions back, the students would say, "That's okay.
ex.t: 然后有人说,"现在你可以用你奶奶的盒子了",从那时起，学生们不但没有来问回他们的财物，反而会说:"没关系。

ex.s: Instead, as many as 800, 000 crowded the roads to the bridge.
ex.t: 相反，多达80万人挤满了通往大桥的道路。

ex.s: Instead, one activist, dressed in a full-body monkey suit, had arrived with a sign praising the filmmakers: "Thanks for not using real apes (猿)!"
ex.t: 相反，一位身着全身猴子装的活动人士举着一块称赞电影制作人的牌子出现：“感谢你们没有使用真猿！”

ex.s: Now he hopes that other cities will consider making their streets run smarter instead of just making them bigger.
ex.t: 现在，他希望其他城市能够考虑让它们的街道变得更智能，而不仅仅是让它们变得更大。

ex.s: Examples and dialogues are recorded with real native speakers instead of automatic computers.
ex.t: 例句和对话是由真正的母语者录制的，而不是用自动电脑生成的。

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点，他相信GI带来的最重风险并非来自对全人类的背叛，而是来自于以牺牲其他一切为代价，对既定目标的顽强追求。

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 从窗户能看到树枝的医院病人，康复速度可能比看建筑和天空的病人更快。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: By the time she was 13，her company was worth millions of dollars with the invention of a super-sweet treat that could save kids' teeth，instead of destroying them.
ex.t: 到她13岁时，她发明了一种超级甜食，能够保护孩子的牙齿而不是损害它们，这使她的公司价值数百万美元。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: Another reason for corn’s rise: The government encourages farmers to grow corn instead of rice   64   (improve) water quality.
ex.t: 玉米崛起的另一个原因：政府鼓励农民种玉米而非水稻，____64____（改善）水质。

ex.s: From the experience I learned a lot about how the attitude of the leader can （18）     the members of a team． Instead of seeing my boys as losers， I pushed and （19）     them． I helped them to see themselves（20）     ， and they built themselves into winners．
ex.t: 从这次经历中，我学到很多关于领导者态度如何（18）___团队成员。我没有把孩子们看作失败者，而是推动并（19）___他们。我帮他们（20）___看待自己，他们把自己打造成赢家。

ex.s: Future 3D food printers could make processed food healthier． Hod Lipson， a professor at Columbia University， said， "Food printing could allow consumer to print food with customized nutritional content， like vitamins． So instead of eating a piece of yesterday 's bread from the supermarket， you'd eat something baked just for you on demand．"
ex.t: 未来的3D食品打印机可以让加工食品更健康。哥伦比亚大学教授霍德·利普森说：“食品打印可以让消费者打印出具有定制营养含量的食物，比如维生素。所以，你不必吃超市里昨天烤的面包，而是可以随时吃到专门为你现烤的食物。”

ex.s: Instead of walking a few blocks to pick up a child or the dry cleaning, they send the self-driving minibus.
ex.t: 他们不是步行几个街区去接孩子或取干洗的衣服，而是派出自动驾驶小巴。

ex.s: 38    Instead, we had a pop-up camper with comfortable beds and an air conditioner.
ex.t: 38    相反，我们有了一辆带有舒适床铺和空调的折叠式房车。

ex.s: Yet instead of being discouraged by my   54   progress, I was excited.
ex.t: 然而，我没有因为进展____而气馁，反而很兴奋。

ex.s: Instead, she is earning $6,500 a day as  62   model in New York.
ex.t: 相反，她作为纽约的62个模特每天挣到6500美元。

ex.s: Benjamin decided that cat hair would work instead.
ex.t: 本杰明决定用猫毛代替。

ex.s: Instead of using up 219kg of steel, we’ve use only 6kg.
ex.t: 我们没有用掉219公斤钢，而只用了6公斤。

ex.s: Instead, reconstruct the key information to make the paragraph coherent, concise and natural.
ex.t: 相反，重新组织关键信息，使段落连贯、简洁、自然。

ex.s: In another letter, Father Christmas complained about how he could not stop his helpers playing games with the toys instead of wrappings them up.
ex.t: 在另一封信中，圣诞老人抱怨说，他无法阻止他的助手们玩玩具，而不是把玩具包起来。

ex.s: Walk or ride a bike instead of taking a car.
ex.t: 走路或骑自行车，而不是开车。

ex.s: How would you expect others to truly understand your emotions if you only shared good news instead of bad?
ex.t: 如果你只分享好消息而不是坏消息，你怎能指望别人真正理解你的情绪呢？
